descriptions.d24j_filter_targets_by_kind_80177270: Iterates a source and, for items whose kind equals the argument, adds the item's target to a new shared list through the adder of its run-time type, then passes the list to the sink and returns 0.
descriptions.d24j_filter_targets_by_flags_8017768c: Same as the kind filter, selecting items whose flags (virtual slot 10) intersect the mask argument.
